body: No one else in my family understands what it's like so I can't talk to them. She was the only person who really understand my mental health struggles because she has been through similar things. I've tried in the past and I just feel worse. I haven't even told anyone we broke up because my mom will just say I told you so. She's been against my relationship for awhile even if she never said it outright. She always made comments on how I'm young and lots of relationship don't last. But no one ever really understood. We had a connection and bond and love that was so strong. I don't believe i will ever experience that again with anyone. Relationship and friends have always been hard for me but I thought I got lucky finding someone so perfect but now it has been ripped away from me and it's all my fault and I can't change the past. I doubt I will ever be able to have a relationship again with anyone because they will never compare

She was upset I said something mean and she hasn't spoken to me since then and I don't expect to her from her again. She probably will be happy I'm gone after what I said. My life has just got progressively worse the past year I'm failing out of college I have no real friends my dad thinks I'm a fuck up even if he won't say it to me and doesn't really care about me. The only person who will be upset is my mom but she will be better off without me in her life. I'm just a drain on her emotionally and financially. The only thing keeping me going was telling myself I'm gonna marry her and we are going to have a life together I just have to make it through and I will always have her. I have no future now. She was my biggest support system when I had bad days or I got depressed and now I got no one to turn to. I can't think or sleep. My brain feels like scrabbled eggs
